messages:
marie_ops: Heads up — Luna forwarded an update: split AWB, ~12 H100s currently held at FRA customs, ETA slipping to next week. We need a routing + allocation plan, and to confirm RMA/DOA handling if any units fail QC on arrival. Who can take point? :eyes:
vendor-luna: Sorry about the noise — customs flagged paperwork mismatch. Forwarder says they can refile but that adds ~48-72h. AWB: 220-LE-9091. We're prepping photos and serial list now.
sam_procure: Can we confirm which 12 physical SKUs these are? Are any reserved for enterprise Dedicated accounts (contracted)? I see 4 committed to us-west dedicated pool, 3 to eu-central, rest for normal hosted pool.
alex_infra: If we lose the 4 us-west units for 48–72h, we need to spill traffic to the on-demand hostable fraction. I can throttle low-priority jobs and temporarily mark some capacity as "maintenance" to preserve SLOs. Need procurement cost delta for expedited air if we ask vendor.
lee_logistics: For expedited air from FRA to us-west we've got two quotes: standard refile+sea -> +0 (delay); air-expedite via DHL global + €12k for the lot (2–3 day ETA once cleared). Freight insurance will cover DOA? Check policy.
jordan_vm: Quick note — our staging racks in eu-central currently have 2 spare slots but thermal testing queue is full. If we reassign eu units to replace us-west, eu tests will back up 24h. That's probably acceptable for non-critical customers.
marie_ops: @vendor-luna can you post the serial list and the paperwork mismatch details here? also confirm whether vendor will cover expedited freight if paperwork error is on their side.
vendor-luna: Serial list attached (sensitive) — sending via secure link: https://files.luna.example/secure/awb-220LE9091/serials.txt. Paperwork issue: HS code mis-declared (we used 8471.80, customs expects 8542.x). Our agent admits error; vendor will cover refile cost and will contribute to expedite if elected.
sam_procure: If vendor pays expedite partially, what's the net cost to us? Lee, can you run numbers for air-expedite + vendor contribution? Also outline cost of customer credits if SLAs breach.
lee_logistics: Running quick math: DHL air-expedite quote €12k. Vendor offered 50% credit for expedite if error is theirs — nets €6k. Insurance deductible likely €1.2k if we claim DOA. Customer SLA credit hit: estimated $8k uplift across impacted customers if we reroute and drop some throughput. Net delta if expedite = €6k + $8k (SLA exposure) + ops hours ~ minimal. If we don't expedite and delay 72h, SLA hit lower (customers tolerate short blips), but revenue opportunity loss may be higher for some large jobs.
alex_infra: Operational recommendation: 1) Mark the 4 us-west H100s as delayed, 2) shift two high-priority queues to Dedicated burst lanes in eu-central for 36h, 3) run conservative CPU fallbacks for non-critical jobs—should keep p95 latencies within SLO.
jordan_vm: Will need a canary for the eu-central shift — I'll spin 2 test nodes and verify KV cache warmup times. Expect ~15–20 min to validate.
marie_ops: Decision time — do we ask vendor to expedite at 50% cost share or accept 72h delay and run the overflow plan? Vote with short replies below.
vendor-luna: We will confirm 50% expedite contribution now.
sam_procure: Expedite — vendor credit makes it worth it for critical dedicated customers.
alex_infra: Expedite only if vendor signs to guaranteed arrival window + updated serial manifest. Otherwise implement overflow plan.
lee_logistics: I can book expedite if procurement ok. I'll draft PO amendment and hold until vendor confirmation.
jordan_vm: Overflow plan standby. If expedite confirmed I'll cancel tests.
marie_ops: OK proceeding: @vendor-luna confirm in thread and I'll approve PO for the €12k booking with 50% vendor credit. Also flag RMA flow: if any unit fails post-depot QC, do we send immediate RMA to vendor depot or handle repairs locally?
vendor-luna: Confirmed 50% expedite credit and we'll guarantee next-flight manifest with courier ETA Fri 10:00 CET. For DOA: vendor request is to return to vendor depot in FRA for warranty RTB. They will reimburse return freight and provide temporary spares under loaner program — need RMA initiation within 5 calendar days.
sam_procure: Acceptable. We prefer vendor depot RTB to simplify serial reconciliation. We require temporary loaners committed in writing.
lee_logistics: Noted. RMA steps: 1) depot acceptance photos & serials, 2) vendor RMA# issued, 3) ship back AWB + return manifest. I'll prep a template RMA email and logistics checklist.
alex_infra: Operational ask: please ensure loaner units are compatible firmware/driver versions. We lost 2 hours once last quarter due to mismatched firmware.
vendor-luna: We'll lock loaners to matching firmware family and include flash images.
jordan_vm: I'll validate firmware on arrival.
marie_ops: Deploy-bot creating incident ticket for tracking (INC-39821). Keep updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Incident INC-39821 created by marie_ops — Owner: sam_procure, Severity: P2, Tags: [procurement, rma, freight].
marie_ops: Thanks everyone. Lee — hold the PO until I post confirm. Once vendor posts manifest and new ETA I'll signal proceed.
lee_logistics: PO held. I'll standby for manifest + updated AWB.
marie_ops: Closing loop here — vendor posted manifest at 1767777820, DHL booking in progress. Tracking will update in thread.
